# iosxr_cef_accounting (Resource)

This resource can manage the CEF Accounting configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxr_cef_accounting" "example" {
  interfaces_mpls_ipv4_rsvp_te                            = true
  interfaces_segment_routing_mpls_ipv4                    = true
  interfaces_segment_routing_mpls_ipv6                    = true
  prefixes_ipv6_mode_per_prefix_per_nexthop_srv6_locators = true
  segment_routing_policies_srv6_disable                   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `interfaces_mpls_ipv4_rsvp_te` (Boolean) Enable RSVP-TE accounting
- `interfaces_segment_routing_mpls_ipv4` (Boolean) Enable IPv4 accounting
- `interfaces_segment_routing_mpls_ipv6` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 accounting
- `prefixes_ipv6_mode_per_prefix_per_nexthop_srv6_locators` (Boolean) Segment-routing SRv6 locator prefixes only
- `segment_routing_policies_srv6_disable` (Boolean) Disable all policy accounting
  - Supported from version: `25.4`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxr_cef_accounting.example ""
```
